title: THE TRUTH ABOUT SIMON PETER—WHAT RELIGION DOESN’T WANT YOU TO KNOW!
paragraphs: THE TRUTH ABOUT SIMON PETER—WHAT RELIGION DOESN’T WANT YOU TO KNOW!

THE TRUTH ABOUT SIMON PETER!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I’ve heard so many different things about Simon Peter. Some say he was the foundation of the church, others say he was the first pope, and some even claim he had special authority above the other apostles. What is the TRUTH?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people believe man-made traditions about Simon Peter instead of what the Bible actually teaches!
🚨 THE SHOCKING TRUTH: SIMON PETER WAS A DISCIPLE, BUT HE WAS NOT WHO RELIGION CLAIMS HE WAS!

📖 Matthew 16:18 (KJV)
"And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it."

🔥 TODAY, WE WILL UNCOVER:
✔️ The REAL role of Simon Peter in the early church
✔️ The LIES that religion teaches about him
✔️ What Jesus actually meant when He said, "Upon this rock I will build my church"
🚨 The truth may SHOCK you—but you cannot ignore it!

THE TRUTH REVEALED – WHO WAS SIMON PETER, REALLY?
📖 Matthew 4:18-19 (KJV)
"And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers. And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
Simon Peter was just a simple fisherman when Jesus called him. He was not a religious leader, not a scholar, and certainly not a pope!

✅ 1. SIMON PETER WAS A DISCIPLE—NOT A SUPREME LEADER!
Some believe that Peter was above the other apostles, but the Bible NEVER teaches this!

📖 Matthew 23:8-9 (KJV)
"But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren. And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Jesus NEVER gave Peter authority over the church—He is our ONLY Master!
✔️ All the apostles were equal as brethren—Peter had no special rank!
✔️ No man is the head of the church—ONLY JESUS IS!
🚨 THE WARNING: If someone tells you Peter was the highest authority, they are promoting a FALSE doctrine!
💡 QUESTION: Do you follow man-made traditions, or do you follow Jesus alone?

✅ 2. WAS PETER THE "ROCK" THAT JESUS BUILT THE CHURCH ON?
Many people believe that when Jesus said, "Upon this rock I will build my church," He was talking about Peter—but is that true?

📖 Matthew 16:18 (KJV)
"And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ The word "Peter" (Petros) means "small stone."
✔️ The word "Rock" (Petra) means "massive foundation stone."
✔️ Jesus was NOT saying Peter is the foundation—HE WAS TALKING ABOUT HIMSELF!

📖 1 Corinthians 3:11 (KJV)
"For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ."
🚨 THE TRUTH: The church is built on JESUS—not on Peter!
💡 QUESTION: Do you trust in Christ alone, or do you follow religious traditions?

✅ 3. PETER WAS NOT INFALLIBLE—HE MADE SERIOUS MISTAKES!
If Peter was supposedly the "leader of the church," why did he fail so many times?

📖 Matthew 16:22-23 (KJV)
"Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee. But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter was REBUKED by Jesus and even called "Satan" because of his wrong mindset!
✔️ Peter was NOT the "rock"—Jesus is the only foundation!
✔️ If Peter was infallible, why did he deny Jesus three times?
🚨 THE WARNING: No man is above failure—ONLY JESUS is perfect!
💡 QUESTION: Do you put your faith in men, or in Christ alone?

WHO WAS SIMON PETER, REALLY?
📖 John 1:42 (KJV)
"And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Jesus changed Simon’s name to Peter (Cephas), meaning “stone”—but He did NOT say Peter was the foundation!
✔️ The true foundation is JESUS CHRIST alone!

📖 Ephesians 2:20 (KJV)
"And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone."
🚨 THE WARNING: The church is NOT built on Peter—it is built on JESUS!
💡 QUESTION: Is your faith built on Christ, or on religious deception?

✅ 4. PETER WAS NOT THE "CHIEF APOSTLE"—PAUL REBUKED HIM!
If Peter was supposed to be the highest leader of the church, why did Paul rebuke him publicly?

📖 Galatians 2:11-14 (KJV)
"But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed... But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?"

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter was WRONG for fearing men instead of obeying God!
✔️ Paul had to correct him because he was leading others into hypocrisy!
✔️ If Peter was the "pope," why would Paul publicly rebuke him?
🚨 THE WARNING: Peter was NOT supreme—he was just another apostle like the rest!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following church traditions, or are you standing on biblical truth?

✅ 5. PETER NEVER CLAIMED TO BE THE HEAD OF THE CHURCH!
If Peter was supposedly the leader of the entire church, why didn’t he say so?

📖 1 Peter 5:1-3 (KJV)
"The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder... Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter calls himself a fellow elder—NOT a pope, ruler, or supreme leader!
✔️ He warns against lording over God’s people, which is what false religious leaders do today!
✔️ Peter understood that Christ alone is the Head of the Church!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any church that claims Peter was their "supreme leader" is teaching a lie!
💡 QUESTION: Do you believe what the Bible says, or what religious tradition teaches?

✅ 6. EVEN PETER HIMSELF POINTED TO JESUS—NOT TO HIMSELF!
Peter NEVER told anyone to follow him—he always pointed to Christ!

📖 Acts 4:10-12 (KJV)
"Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole. This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner. Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter preached that Jesus is the Cornerstone and the ONLY way to salvation!
✔️ He NEVER told people to put their faith in him!
✔️ If Peter was truly "the foundation of the church," why did he always point to Jesus?
🚨 THE WARNING: Any religion that puts Peter in Christ’s place is leading people into deception!
💡 QUESTION: Who do you trust for salvation—Jesus or religious tradition?

WHO WAS SIMON PETER, REALLY?
📖 Matthew 10:2 (KJV)
"Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter was one of many apostles—he was NOT above them!
✔️ He had a leadership role, but not supremacy over the church!
✔️ His calling was to preach the Gospel—not to be a ruler over God’s people!
🚨 THE WARNING: Peter was a servant of Christ, NOT the "Vicar of Christ!"
💡 QUESTION: Are you following a man-centered religion or the true Gospel of Jesus?

✅ 7. PETER WAS MARRIED—SO HOW COULD HE BE A "POPE"?
Many religious traditions teach that Peter was the first pope and that popes must remain unmarried. But the Bible clearly says Peter had a wife!

📖 Matthew 8:14 (KJV)
"And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter was a married man!
✔️ The idea that Peter was a celibate "pope" is completely FALSE!
✔️ Nowhere does the Bible command leaders to remain unmarried!

📖 1 Timothy 4:1-3 (KJV)
"Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils; Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth."
🚨 THE WARNING: Any religion that forbids marriage is teaching a DOCTRINE OF DEVILS!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following the Bible’s teaching or religious deception?

✅ 8. PETER DID NOT HAVE THE "KEYS TO HEAVEN"—JESUS DOES!
Many believe that Peter is standing at the "gates of Heaven," deciding who enters. But the Bible teaches that Jesus ALONE has the keys!

📖 Revelation 1:18 (KJV)
"I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Only Jesus has the authority over Heaven and Hell!
✔️ Peter is not the "gatekeeper"—that is a man-made lie!
✔️ No man can decide your eternal fate—ONLY JESUS CAN!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you believe Peter controls Heaven’s gates, you have been deceived!
💡 QUESTION: Do you trust in Christ ALONE, or in religious myths?

✅ 9. PETER HIMSELF REJECTED THE IDEA OF HUMAN WORSHIP!
If Peter was truly the supreme leader of the church, why did he REFUSE to let people bow before him?

📖 Acts 10:25-26 (KJV)
"And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him. But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter did NOT accept worship or special treatment!
✔️ He refused to be honored as if he was more than just a man!
✔️ Yet today, many religious leaders expect people to bow before them!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any church that elevates a man to godlike status is in rebellion against God!
💡 QUESTION: Do you worship Jesus alone, or do you follow man-made religion?

✅ 10. PETER DID NOT START THE CHURCH IN ROME—PAUL DID!
Many believe Peter was the first bishop of Rome and founded the church there, but the Bible says otherwise!

📖 Romans 15:20 (KJV)
"Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ The apostle Paul, not Peter, was sent to Rome!
✔️ Paul said he did NOT build on another man’s foundation—meaning Peter was NOT in Rome!
✔️ The idea of Peter being the "first pope" in Rome is a complete historical lie!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your church claims Peter was the first leader of Rome, they are promoting a FALSE HISTORY!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following the Word of God or the traditions of men?

WHO WAS SIMON PETER, REALLY?
📖 John 6:68-69 (KJV)
"Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life. And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter confessed that JESUS is the Christ—the true foundation of the church!
✔️ Peter NEVER pointed to himself as the leader of the faith.
✔️ He recognized that only Jesus has the words of eternal life!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your faith is built on a man instead of Christ, you are on sinking sand!
💡 QUESTION: Who is your foundation—Jesus or religious tradition?

✅ 11. PETER NEVER CLAIMED TO HAVE SUPREME AUTHORITY—HE CALLED HIMSELF A SERVANT!
If Peter was the highest leader of the church, why did he humble himself as a servant?

📖 2 Peter 1:1 (KJV)
"Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter called himself a servant, NOT a pope, ruler, or head of the church!
✔️ He saw himself as an equal among other believers, NOT above them!
✔️ Nowhere in Scripture does Peter ever claim supreme authority!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any religious system that elevates Peter above others is a distortion of biblical truth!
💡 QUESTION: Do you see yourself as a servant like Peter, or are you following a system that exalts men?

✅ 12. PETER NEVER WORE A CROWN OR SAT ON A THRONE!
Some religions depict Peter wearing a crown and sitting on a throne as the first "Vicar of Christ." But is this biblical?

📖 Revelation 4:10-11 (KJV)
"The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying, Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Only Jesus sits on the throne—no apostle ever claimed such a position!
✔️ Even the elders in Heaven throw down their crowns before Jesus!
✔️ No man is worthy of glory—ONLY CHRIST!
🚨 THE WARNING: If any church teaches that Peter wore a crown or sat on a throne, they are promoting an unbiblical lie!
💡 QUESTION: Do you give glory to Christ alone, or do you honor men above what is written?

✅ 13. PETER WAS NOT PERFECT—HE EVEN LIED UNDER PRESSURE!
If Peter was the "supreme leader" of the church, why did he FAIL so many times?

📖 Luke 22:57-58 (KJV)
"And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not. And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter denied Christ three times out of fear!
✔️ If he was supposedly "infallible," why did he lie?
✔️ Only Jesus is the perfect, sinless leader of the church!
🚨 THE WARNING: If Peter could fail, no man can claim absolute authority—ONLY CHRIST IS INFALLIBLE!
💡 QUESTION: Are you trusting in a man’s position, or in the perfection of Christ?

✅ 14. THE APOSTLES DID NOT SEE PETER AS THEIR LEADER—THEY ANSWERED TO GOD!
If Peter was truly the highest authority in the church, why did the apostles answer directly to God instead of him?

📖 Acts 5:29 (KJV)
"Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ The apostles did NOT recognize Peter as their supreme leader!
✔️ They made decisions by obeying GOD—not a man-made hierarchy!
✔️ Their loyalty was to Christ, not to a church system!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any religion that places a man above God’s Word is a false system!
💡 QUESTION: Do you follow Christ’s commands or religious traditions?

✅ 15. PETER WAS NOT THE FOUNDATION—JESUS GAVE THE GREAT COMMISSION TO ALL BELIEVERS!
If Peter was the head of the church, why did Jesus give the Great Commission to all His followers?

📖 Matthew 28:18-20 (KJV)
"And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth. Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Jesus gave ALL believers the command to spread the Gospel—not just Peter!
✔️ There is no "one man" who has authority over the entire church!
✔️ Jesus holds ALL power—not any pope, bishop, or leader!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your faith is in a church system instead of Christ, you are deceived!
💡 QUESTION: Do you follow the commands of Jesus, or do you submit to a man-made system?

WHO WAS SIMON PETER, REALLY?
📖 John 21:17 (KJV)
"He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Peter was given a mission—to preach the Gospel and strengthen believers.
✔️ Jesus didn’t say, "Rule over my church," He said, "Feed my sheep!"
✔️ Peter was called to serve, not to reign as a supreme leader!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any system that elevates Peter to a position of supreme power is twisting Jesus' words!
💡 QUESTION: Are you feeding God’s sheep with truth, or following man-made religious authority?

✅ 16. THE FIRST CHURCH COUNCIL WAS NOT LED BY PETER—JAMES HAD AUTHORITY!
If Peter was the leader of the church, why did James preside over the first major church decision?

📖 Acts 15:13-19 (KJV)
"And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me... Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ James—not Peter—made the final decision in the first church council!
✔️ If Peter was the "pope," why didn’t he take charge?
✔️ The church was led by the Holy Spirit, not by one man’s authority!
🚨 THE WARNING: If Peter was the "head of the church," why do we see James making major leadership decisions?
💡 QUESTION: Is your faith built on a biblical foundation, or on religious deception?

✅ 17. PETER NEVER WORE A RELIGIOUS TITLE LIKE "HOLY FATHER" OR "POPE"!
Some religious leaders today take on the title "Holy Father," but what did Jesus say about that?

📖 Matthew 23:9 (KJV)
"And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Jesus FORBIDS calling religious leaders "Father" in a spiritual sense!
✔️ Peter never took a special title—he remained a humble servant!
✔️ There is only ONE Holy Father—GOD in Heaven!
🚨 THE WARNING: If any church leader demands to be called "Holy Father," they are violating Jesus’ direct command!
💡 QUESTION: Do you honor God’s authority, or do you follow man-made religious systems?

✅ 18. PETER WAS NOT GIVEN EXCLUSIVE AUTHORITY TO FORGIVE SINS!
Many religious systems teach that Peter had the power to forgive sins and that this authority was passed down. But is that true?

📖 Mark 2:7 (KJV)
"Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God only?"

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Only GOD has the power to forgive sins!
✔️ Peter never claimed he had authority to forgive people’s sins!
✔️ Religious leaders cannot grant forgiveness—only Jesus can!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you think a man can absolve your sins, you are being deceived!
💡 QUESTION: Are you seeking forgiveness from Christ, or from a religious system?

✅ 19. PETER NEVER SAID HE WAS THE "VICAR OF CHRIST"—THAT TITLE IS BLASPHEMY!
Some claim that Peter was the "Vicar of Christ" (meaning the earthly representative of Jesus), but is that in the Bible?

📖 John 14:16 (KJV)
"And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ Jesus sent the HOLY SPIRIT as His representative—not Peter!
✔️ Nowhere in the Bible does Peter claim to be "Christ on Earth."
✔️ The Holy Spirit leads the church, not a religious leader!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any system that replaces the Holy Spirit with a human leader is in rebellion against God!
💡 QUESTION: Are you being led by the Spirit of God, or by religious deception?

✅ 20. PETER DID NOT RECEIVE A SPECIAL SUCCESSOR—NO APOSTLE DID!
Many religious systems teach that Peter’s authority was passed down through successors. But does the Bible support that?

📖 Acts 1:24-26 (KJV)
"And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen... And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
✔️ When Judas was replaced, the apostles prayed and cast lots—it was NOT based on a "succession system!"
✔️ No apostle had an unbroken "line of authority"—each was called by GOD directly!
✔️ Nowhere in Scripture does it say Peter’s position was passed down!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any religious system that claims an "unbroken line" from Peter is making it up!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following biblical truth, or are you following a religious institution?

EXPOSING THE BIGGEST LIES ABOUT PETER!
Many churches have twisted the truth about Peter to fit their man-made doctrines. It’s time to expose the lies and reveal the truth!

📖 Colossians 2:8 (KJV)
"Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ."
🚨 THE WARNING: False doctrines about Peter are based on TRADITIONS—not the Word of God!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following Jesus, or have you been misled by religious deception?

✅ 1. LIE #1: “PETER WAS THE FIRST POPE”
🔥 THE TRUTH: The Bible NEVER calls Peter a "pope," nor does it give him supreme authority over the church!

📖 1 Peter 5:1-3 (KJV)
"The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder... Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock."

✔️ Peter called himself an elder, not a pope!
✔️ He commanded church leaders NOT to act like lords over the people!
✔️ The early church was led by multiple apostles, not one supreme ruler!
🚨 THE WARNING: The idea of a pope ruling over the church is a man-made doctrine!
💡 QUESTION: Who is the head of your faith—Jesus or religious leaders?

✅ 2. LIE #2: “PETER WAS INFALLIBLE”
🔥 THE TRUTH: Peter made MANY mistakes—he was NOT infallible!

📖 Galatians 2:11 (KJV)
"But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed."

✔️ Peter was publicly rebuked by Paul because he acted in hypocrisy!
✔️ If Peter was infallible, why did he deny Jesus three times?
✔️ Only Jesus Christ is PERFECT—no man is without sin!
🚨 THE WARNING: Any church that claims Peter was "infallible" is teaching deception!
💡 QUESTION: Do you believe in the perfection of Christ, or in the false claim of "infallible" leaders?

✅ 3. LIE #3: “PETER HOLDS THE KEYS TO HEAVEN”
🔥 THE TRUTH: Peter does NOT decide who enters Heaven—only Jesus does!

📖 Revelation 1:18 (KJV)
"I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death."

✔️ Jesus holds the keys—not Peter!
✔️ Peter’s role was to preach the Gospel, NOT to control salvation!
✔️ Nowhere in Scripture does it say Peter is standing at Heaven’s gates!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you believe Peter controls who goes to Heaven, you have been deceived!
💡 QUESTION: Are you trusting in Christ alone for salvation, or in religious myths?

✅ 4. LIE #4: “PETER FOUNDED THE CHURCH IN ROME”
🔥 THE TRUTH: The Bible says Paul—not Peter—was sent to Rome!

📖 Romans 15:20 (KJV)
"Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation."

✔️ Paul made it clear—he did NOT build on another man’s work!
✔️ If Peter had already founded the church in Rome, why would Paul say this?
✔️ The idea that Peter was the first bishop of Rome is a historical lie!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your church claims Peter was the first leader in Rome, they are rewriting history!
💡 QUESTION: Do you follow the truth of Scripture, or do you believe religious propaganda?

✅ 5. LIE #5: “PETER’S AUTHORITY WAS PASSED DOWN THROUGH SUCCESSORS”
🔥 THE TRUTH: No apostle had a "successor"—each was chosen directly by God!

📖 Acts 1:24-26 (KJV)
"And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen... And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles."

✔️ When Judas was replaced, the apostles did NOT choose a successor based on lineage!
✔️ They prayed and cast lots—trusting GOD to choose!
✔️ No biblical evidence supports an unbroken "line of succession" from Peter!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your church claims authority from Peter, they are promoting a man-made lie!
💡 QUESTION: Do you follow Jesus’ authority, or the false claims of religious institutions?

✅ 6. LIE #6: “PETER ALONE WAS GIVEN SPECIAL AUTHORITY”
🔥 THE TRUTH: ALL the apostles were given the same authority to spread the Gospel!

📖 Matthew 28:19-20 (KJV)
"Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you."

✔️ Jesus gave the Great Commission to ALL His disciples—not just Peter!
✔️ Nowhere does the Bible say Peter had exclusive power over the church!
✔️ The early church was led by multiple apostles, NOT by one supreme leader!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you believe Peter had unique authority over all believers, you are following a false doctrine!
💡 QUESTION: Do you believe in the authority of Christ, or in man-made religious power?

✅ 7. LIE #7: “PETER’S POSITION WAS GREATER THAN OTHER DISCIPLES”
🔥 THE TRUTH: Peter was a leader, but he was NOT greater than the other apostles!

📖 Acts 10:34 (KJV)
"Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons."

✔️ Peter himself admitted that God shows no favoritism!
✔️ Jesus never elevated one apostle over the others!
✔️ All believers are part of Christ’s body—no one is greater!
🚨 THE WARNING: If a church claims Peter was above the other apostles, they are teaching deception!
💡 QUESTION: Do you serve humbly like Peter, or do you seek power like religious leaders?

THE FINAL WARNING – YOU CANNOT IGNORE THIS TRUTH!
Jesus has made it clear: The truth will set you free, but deception will lead to destruction! The lies about Peter have been exposed—now YOU must choose.

📖 John 8:32 (KJV)
"And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
